description: This file defines the Response class in the AWS CRT HTTP namespace, representing an HTTP response message with methods for construction, marshalling, unmarshalling, and retrieving status code.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response message, extending the Message class, providing access to status code and methods for serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Response object with method, path, query, headers, and status code.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Deserializes data into a Response object.

methods.name: status_code
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.
